hero.description2: We help users discover trusted businesses, compare services, and book appointments online with full confidence.

intro.label: Why we exist
intro.title: A real problem. A real solution.
intro.subtitle: We noticed a gap between how services are offered and how people actually book them. NOBTY was built to close that gap.

problem.title: The obstacles we noticed
problem.text: Booking a service is still difficult for many customers. People often waste time searching, calling to check availability, and waiting without clear information.
items: No central place to discover services
Phone calls just to check availability

solution.title: What we built
solution.text: NOBTY brings businesses and customers into one simple platform. Users can explore services, check business information, book appointments, and manage their time.
items: Browse and compare businesses in seconds
Businesses manage everything in one place

vision.label: Our vision
vision.title: Building a smarter way to connect services with people.
vision.text1: Our vision is to become a trusted digital booking platform that connects people with reliable service providers across Morocco.
vision.text2: We aim to create a smoother experience where finding, comparing, and booking services becomes simple, transparent, and accessible to everyone.

map.label: Where we operate
map.title: Expanding across Morocco
map.subtitle: NOBTY currently operates in Casablanca, Rabat, and Tangier — with more cities coming soon.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Questions about NOBTY?
faq.subtitle: Here are the key answers about how NOBTY helps users and service providers.

items.question: What is NOBTY?
items.answer: NOBTY is a booking platform that helps customers discover businesses, compare services, and book appointments online.

items.question: Who can use NOBTY?
items.answer: NOBTY is designed for customers who want to book services and businesses that want to manage appointments more professionally.

items.question: Can businesses manage their services on NOBTY?
items.answer: Yes. Providers can manage their profile, services, availability, bookings, and customer interactions from the dashboard.

items.question: Which cities does NOBTY focus on?
items.answer: NOBTY currently focuses on Casablanca, Rabat, and Tangier, with plans to expand to more Moroccan cities.
